item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text:
{"program":"domain(person,[cayden,sebastian,tobias,braden]).

% If someone has culinary skills and collects recipes, then they can create unique dishes.
axiom(s1, rule([culinary_skills(X),collects_recipes(X)],create_unique_dishes(X))).
% Cayden does not enjoy experiments.
axiom(s2, not(enjoys_experiments(cayden))).
% Sebastian is either a skilled food critique or has a good palate, but not both.
axiom(s3, xor(skilled_food_critique(sebastian),good_palate(sebastian))).
% Everyone who appreciates flavors either values cuisine or explores cultures (or both).
axiom(s4, rule([appreciates_flavors(X)],or(values_cuisine(X),explores_cultures(X)))).
% If Sebastian is culturally aware, then he is either an experienced chef or a skilled food critique, but not both.
axiom(s5, implies(culturally_aware(sebastian),xor(experienced_chef(sebastian),skilled_food_critique(sebastian)))).
% If someone keeps a cookbook, then they collect recipes.
axiom(s6, rule([keeps_cookbook(X)],collects_recipes(X))).
% Sebastian does not host dining events.
axiom(s7, not(hosts_dining_events(sebastian))).
% Cayden is culturally aware.
axiom(s8, culturally_aware(cayden)).
% Cayden does not explore cultures.
axiom(s9, not(explores_cultures(cayden))).
% Sebastian does not explore cultures.
axiom(s10, not(explores_cultures(sebastian))).
% If Cayden is well traveled, then he is either an experienced chef or a successful restaurateur, but not both.
axiom(s11, implies(well_traveled(cayden),xor(experienced_chef(cayden),successful_restaurateur(cayden)))).
% Tobias does not enjoy experiments.
axiom(s12, not(enjoys_experiments(tobias))).
% If Cayden values cuisine, then he either collects recipes or hosts dining events (or both).
axiom(s13, implies(values_cuisine(cayden),or(collects_recipes(cayden),hosts_dining_events(cayden)))).
% Cayden masters techniques.
axiom(s14, masters_techniques(cayden)).
% Cayden is either a skilled food critique or has a good palate, but not both.
axiom(s15, xor(skilled_food_critique(cayden),good_palate(cayden))).
% If Cayden is culturally aware, then he is either an experienced chef or a skilled food critique, but not both.
axiom(s16, implies(culturally_aware(cayden),xor(experienced_chef(cayden),skilled_food_critique(cayden)))).
% Anyone who understands flavors and masters techniques has culinary skills.
axiom(s17, rule([understands_flavors(X),masters_techniques(X)],culinary_skills(X))).
% Cayden cannot create unique dishes.
axiom(s18, not(create_unique_dishes(cayden))).
% If someone has a good palate, then they appreciate flavors and enjoy experiments.
axiom(s19, rule([good_palate(X)],and(appreciates_flavors(X),enjoys_experiments(X)))).
% Cayden does not host dining events.
axiom(s20, not(hosts_dining_events(cayden))).
% Sebastian cannot create unique dishes.
axiom(s21, not(create_unique_dishes(sebastian))).
% Sebastian is culturally aware.
axiom(s22, culturally_aware(sebastian)).
% If Cayden owns a restaurant, then he either has culinary skills or specializes in baking, but not both.
axiom(s23, implies(owns_restaurant(cayden),xor(culinary_skills(cayden),specializes_in_baking(cayden)))).
% Cayden is well traveled.
axiom(s24, well_traveled(cayden)).
% Braden masters techniques.
axiom(s25, masters_techniques(braden)).
% Cayden understands flavors.
axiom(s26, understands_flavors(cayden)).
% If Cayden understands nutrition and knows food history, then he can be a skilled food critique.
axiom(s27, rule([understands_nutrition(cayden),knows_food_history(cayden)],skilled_food_critique(cayden))).","query":"labelled_explanation(successful_restaurateur(cayden),Status,Package)"}
